curriculum: Appendix F confirms the 180 EC single-major Physics and Astronomy bachelor for 2026–2027. Teaching is Dutch in year 1, mainly Dutch in year 2 and predominantly English in year 3. The 135 EC major includes 75 EC of taught compulsory courses and the 15 EC supervised project. Its 45 EC elective space includes one 7.5 EC required choice at level 2 and 37.5 EC of major electives including at least 30 EC at level 3. The remaining 45 EC is profiling. Climate, experimental and theoretical physics are study-advice paths, not compulsory degree routes.
progression: The first-year rules include six taught compulsory courses, one profiling course and one major elective. Atmosphere and Ocean Dynamics is a first-year eligible elective, offered in period 3, with mechanics and calculus preparation. The earlier example fixed level-3 courses without proving timetable and preparation compatibility. The corrected comparison gives the actual four-course choice and illustrates geophysical fluid dynamics and turbulence without assigning them to semesters. Fluid Mechanics and Transport Phenomena calls for Mathematical Techniques 1–3. Advanced Quantum Mechanics builds on Quantum Mechanics and Mathematical Techniques 1–3. Geophysical Fluid Dynamics builds on wave dynamics and continuum or fluid mechanics, while Turbulence in Fluids calls for fluid mechanics and thermodynamics. The final research project normally requires the compulsory taught courses and at least 90 EC, a supervised project agreed before the semester and signed paperwork; exceptions require approval. It culminates in a written thesis and oral presentation.
components: Example major elective. Study the forces and balances governing atmospheric and ocean circulation.
Arrange a supervised project before the semester begins. Utrecht normally requires completion of the compulsory taught courses and at least 90 EC before starting.
Choose Fluid Mechanics and Transport Phenomena or Structure of Matter.
Choose four approved level-3 courses. Climate-related examples include Geophysical Fluid Dynamics and Turbulence in Fluids.
Choose courses to broaden or deepen your studies within Utrecht’s profiling rules.
